last.verdict: Cloudflare's growth sped up to 39% and the year's outlook jumped, but costs of delivering service and heavier spending are squeezing margins.

takeaways.label: Growth accelerating, outlook raised
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 39% to $782.5M, up from 36% last quarter and the fastest in nearly four years. Full-year revenue guidance rose to about $2.963B from $2.864–2.870B.

takeaways.label: Bigger customers spending more
takeaways.text: Existing customers grew spending 22% year over year (net retention 122%, up from 120% last quarter). Customers paying over $100K a year rose 25% to 5,006.

takeaways.label: Gross margin keeps sliding
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin fell to 72.4% from 75.3% a year ago. Profit margin still rose to 17.5% from 15.3% because other costs grew slower than revenue.

takeaways.label: Heavier spending, thinner cash
takeaways.text: Equipment and infrastructure spending hit $121.8M, so free cash flow margin slipped to 10% from 13%. Management guides network spending at about 14–15% of annual revenue.

history.verdict: Accelerating growth and a raised full-year outlook won buyers, though much of the after-hours pop faded.

reasons.label: Growth sped up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 36% from a year earlier, up from 34% last quarter, beating expectations.

reasons.label: Margins and one-time costs
reasons.text: Gross margin fell to 73.1% from 76.3%; a $150.7M restructuring charge weighed on results.
